notes.title: New version of Tinker Bell / Upcoming Once a Porn a Time
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone! 
Here is the final version of the Tinker Bell Fairy for the upcoming [b][i]"Once a Porn a Time"[/i][/b] game! 💚

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891385/1eb2c4aafbfd6e09de6cc8dc1af28aeb3fdf6583.png"][/img]
I think this version is just perfect, it's like with Emee, she's instantly recognizable and the style is much more professional. [/p][p]With the great animations we have now, it will be just EXCELLENT! ✨ [/p][p]So, she will have two heads in-game, a "Fairy" version and a "Human size" version. [/p][p]I made a little image to show you the actual size difference in-game: 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891385/b5310cd9ea10010a8cd96c30f51dfdf21e3ad577.jpg"][/img]
[i]I love her so much 💚💚💚

[/i]As you can imagine, we couldn't realistically keep the fairy head for the human size, proportionally it would have looked too strange. So we're going with two versions![/p][p]I think her personality comes across well in both versions. And she'll be able to swap between them in-game whenever she wants!

In other news, we're continuing to work on both the next OPT and the end of PnC!

You can really feel that we have good organization, things are moving fast and smoothly, it's quite nice! ahah Anyway, I can't wait to release the final update of PnC on Steam, the game is rated [i]"Very Positive"[/i], so we can only expect a good launch!

And also, don't hesitate to wishlist "Porn and Cards" on Steam if you're waiting for the final release, that way you won't miss it and it helps me A LOT!
[/p][p]See you in a few days for the release of the next PnC update!
Bye ~~[i]
[/i][/p]

notes.title: Behind the Scenes of Our New Tinker in WIP
notes.notes:
[p]Hello! 
I rarely post two announcements in a row, but I think this time it’s necessary! 
[b]First of all, thank you for the warm welcome you gave our new Tinker![/b]  
The upcoming OPT is getting a major artistic overhaul, and it’s great to see that you’re enjoying the work we’re doing. 💚[/p][p][b][u]BUT[/u][/b] — and this is why I’m making today’s post — a lot of people think our new Tinker is just an AI-generated image. I hesitated at first about whether I should respond, but I’d rather build a relationship based on trust with you, and (even if it breaks the magic a bit) show you the real work that goes into creating such polished characters 🪄  
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375170/9a9b1c9c63033a9751ac19220557fd5d68fcf868.png"][/img][i]I managed to dig up as much as I could from our early creation steps — it’s been a while, I have to admit (we actually started working on this new Tinker back in 2024~).

[/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375170/7eca5535cfa28500fe63a73a6d7826ba79da1572.png"][/img][i]We do a lot of pose research before finalizing a character — aside from the face, it’s really in the pose that you start to feel the soul and personality of a character.

[/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375170/0c5b13cfb4891bc676b2ea90eb83bb4ca5113c6c.png"][/img][i] For a NSFW game, color is something especially important. (Yes, I know — the naked characters matter too xD — but color sets the mood and the overall harmony.) It’s our job to make sure everything feels just right… so that you never even notice it!

[/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375170/b6f8787f55e60f47e2436e679f4b28eba467e446.gif"][/img][i] Yeah, it’s silly, but we just added a single layer for the eye highlights — and it gives this amazing effect ~ Personally, I never get tired of it [/i]💚 [i]
[/i] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42375170/9f0282fe22f62bd019ae14a146e589e880baa93f.gif"][/img][i]And here, you can see how many layers we’re working with! Yep, our files are massive — but don’t worry, we’ve got good hard drives too, ahah!

[/i]To wrap things up, I think it’s fair to say we really care about what we create. We’re genuinely trying to deliver a high level of visual quality for the upcoming OPT — and we’re giving it everything we’ve got to get there.[/p][p]( That said, I’m telling you now: I’m not doing this full presentation for every single character! Ahah 😅 )[/p][p]But honestly, in a time where more and more 2D games (And especially for NSFW games) just generate a random AI-made character and call it a day, we felt it was important to show you how [i]we[/i] do things, properly.[/p][p]That’s it! Thanks a lot, and have a great day! Bye ~[/p]

notes.title: Meet the New Tinker! (OPT 2025)
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Hope you're all doing great![/p][p][/p][p]As many of you have seen on our socials, on top of working on our little game "Porn and Cards", we've also started [b][i]development on the next OPT![/i][/b][/p][p]And oh boy, this game is going to look stunning.[/p][p]Get ready for a serious visual upgrade![/p][p][/p][p]And to give you a little sneak peek... [b]Here’s your first official look at the new Tinker![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891385/72ffa1fa3b2ec162828b12753cf8b11ee2258527.png"][/img]Not concept art. Not a mockup. This is exactly how she’ll look and move in-game —[/p][p][/p][p]We even did a little side-by-side with her 2019 version...[/p][p]Let’s just say: the glow-up is real. 😏[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891385/d7564025d50175ff0b3f4e9f7029f174f69b01ff.png"][/img][/p][p]Tinker is just the beginning — after her, all the old characters will be remade, new ones will be created (New princesses to corrupt, of course...🔥) and the next game will include all the improvements we developed on PnC![/p][p][/p][p]We’re not just aiming for a new chapter of OPT — we want to create the best NSFW trainer/corruption game in a fairytale world ever made.[/p][p]THE game every 2D trainer fan has been waiting for.[/p][p][/p][p](Yeah, no less than that.)[/p][p][/p][p]Anyway, I hope you like the new Tinker — and I’ll see you soon![/p][p]— Salty01[/p]

notes.title: BugFix // OPT2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
So... yeah, let's start with the most important thing: I took a bit too long to do this bugfix, and for that, I apologize.
I'm not going to make up crazy excuses, I was just overwhelmed with the new game and didn't manage things well. I'll do my best to make sure this doesn't happen again.

Today's bugfix addresses issues with Princess Saphire, her dress getting stuck with Lyco, and the decoration achievement problem.

That should be the last three remaining bugs to fix for this game.
Once again, sorry about that.

Wishing you all a great day and a fun game.

notes.title: Love & Cards Early Access OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everyone!
Our new game "[b]Love & Cards[/b]" is now available in Early Access![/h2]

[i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3017700/Love__Cards/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3017700/Love__Cards/[/url][/b][/i]

Set in the same universe as OPT 1 & 2, this new game introduces you to brand-new characters and adventures on the planet New Frontier!
This game is a mix of a visual novel, a card game, a point-and-click, and a romance game! (Yes, a lot all at once!)

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44891385/7cb41f24648a4cdb680f9350fb0df1fe100cae7e.png[/img]

In this first update, which offers nearly an hour of content, you’ll get to experience all the new features we’ve added to the game: improved graphics, more animations, voice-acted dialogues, and much more advanced storytelling than before!

I wish you all an amazing time playing! Don’t hesitate to leave a positive review if you enjoyed it (it helps a lot)!
And most importantly, share your feedback with us! Our goal is to create the best game possible!

Have a great day, everyone!
Bye ~~
